title: ENFORCEMENT RULES OF THE ACT ON THE PROMOTION OF EDUCATION IN ISLANDS AND REMOTE AREAS
full_text:
ENFORCEMENT RULES OF THE ACT ON THE PROMOTION OF EDUCATION IN ISLANDS AND REMOTE AREAS

Article 1 (Purpose)
The purpose of these Rules is to designate islands and remote areas pursuant to Article 2 of the Act on the Promotion of Education in Islands and Remote Areas (hereinafter referred to as the "Act"). <Amended on Mar. 15, 2005>

Article 2 (Islands and Remote Areas and Their Classification by Grade)
The islands and remote areas under Article 2 of the Act and their classification by grade shall be as specified in the Appendix.
[This Article Wholly Amended on Dec. 31, 1985]
